stem: Control stores grew 10% in the promotion week without any promotion. In the test stores, the uplift against their own pre-period is 25%. What does this say about the 25%?

options.text: Part of it is market growth, so the promotion's own uplift is lower
The uplift is understated, because the market grew at the same time
The control stores are unusable, because their sales grew
The 25% is right, because only the test stores had the promotion
